image_description: Two men standing on a boat holding a very large sturgeon horizontally. The background features a river and mountains under an overcast sky. The sturgeon is the primary subject, displaying characteristic bony scutes along its side.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated head with protrusible mouth on ventral surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is visible but the angle and resolution prevent clear verification of the ventral mouth position; however, the snout shape appears consistent.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Four barbels (sensory whiskers) anterior to mouth.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Barbels are too small to be resolved at this image resolution and distance; effectively invisible.
The snout is clearly pointed and elongated, matching the sturgeon morphology.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated fusiform body with impressively large, extended proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The fish is extremely long and fusiform, spanning the width of the boat and held by two people.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Five rows of bony scutes (plates) along body instead of scales.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Distinct rows of large, bony scutes are clearly visible along the lateral line and dorsal area.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Gray, brown, or black dorsally with lighter ventral surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The dorsal side is dark gray/brown, fading to a white/lighter belly, consistent with sturgeon coloration.
The tail extends out of the frame on the right side; it is not visible.

The hands holding the fish appear somewhat indistinct and merge slightly with the fish's body and gloves, lacking clear finger definition typical of AI generation or heavy compression artifacts.
